feature_title: Export Alerts & SLOs as Terraform (Export Resource Dialog)

rationale.edition: All 40 changed paths live under web/src/**, tests/ui-testing/**, and scripts/translations/** — no enterprise-owned directory (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) is touched. The symbols are Terraform/OpenTofu export and HCL highlighting, none of which are enterprise-gated keywords (no SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo-management), so this is an open-source frontend change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out: feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty (no tests-added label, no skip comment). The change is user-facing — alert and SLO export switch from a direct download to a new review dialog — so the docs-only/CI-only skip condition does not apply.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The alert export flow (web/src/components/alerts/AlertList.vue) changes from an immediate JSON download to a new ExportResourceDialog that offers JSON and Terraform tabs with copy/download, and the same dialog is wired into the SLO list (web/src/views/slos/SloList.vue). These are new user-exercisable interactions that need browser-level verification.
rationale.area: Alerts is the primary surface: the largest behavioral change is in web/src/components/alerts/AlertList.vue plus web/src/utils/alerts/alertTerraform.ts, and the diff updates the existing Alerts E2E page object (tests/ui-testing/pages/alertsPages/alertsPage.js) for the new dialog. SLO export (web/src/views/slos/SloList.vue) is also touched but is secondary.
rationale.group: Alerts — the existing 'Alerts' testfolder (actual_folder: Alerts) already runs alerts-import.spec.js, alerts-ui-operations.spec.js and alerts-e2e-flow.spec.js, so the new alert-export spec joins that matrix shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only Playwright file changed is tests/ui-testing/pages/alertsPages/alertsPage.js — a page object, not a spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. The .spec.ts files (AlertList.spec.ts, ExportResourceDialog.spec.ts, SloListExport.spec.ts, etc.) are Vitest unit tests under web/src/** and do not count as E2E coverage.
